description: Create an invoice without a quote (AI can draft lines; the owner approves them before the invoice is sent). Optional due date, memo and deposit. Send it with invoices.send.

kind.description: item (default), fee (trip charge, disposal, card fee) or discount. For a discount, enter the amount off as a positive unit_price_minor.

taxable.description: Counts toward tax when the quote or invoice has a tax rate. Default true.

tax_rate_id.description: Tax rate to charge. Leave out for the shop default rate; null for no tax.

name: invoices_create
